links.outcome: Performance degradation under domain shift from synthetic training data to real VA clinical notes
links.effect: LLM-based models transferred well to real VA notes (macro-F1 up to 87.22%), but traditional ML models and transformer encoders showed greater performance degradation under domain shift.
links.quote: In contrast, traditional machine learning models and transformer encoders exhibited greater performance degradation under domain shift and derived limited benefit from increasing synthetic training data.

unlisted_practices: Using LLM-generated synthetic data in place of expert-annotated real clinical data to train classifiers

screen.reason: The study evaluates the use of LLM-generated synthetic clinical notes for training models to detect parole/probation status, benchmarking performance against annotated real-world VA clinical notes without testing a specific organizational deployment safeguard or clinical workflow practice.
